title: Global Regulatory & Statutory Open Metadata Index (2024–2026) — 41,185 Official Dossiers Across 38 Jurisdictions
description:
Automated, machine-readable bibliographic metadata catalog (CSV, JSONL, Frictionless Data Package, and complete per-jurisdiction Markdown directories) indexing 41,185 official primary and secondary laws, final and proposed rules, statutory instruments, central bank circulars, supreme audit reports, and multilateral resolutions across 921 government departments, ministries, regulatory agencies, and multilateral organs in 38 active jurisdictions: United States (15,424 dossiers | Catalog), United Kingdom (2,984 dossiers | Catalog), Canada (5,384 dossiers | Catalog), European Union (5,144 dossiers | Catalog), United Nations (6,984 dossiers | Catalog), Ireland (186 dossiers | Catalog), Australia (1,312 dossiers | Catalog), International (1,124 dossiers | Catalog), Austria (171 dossiers | Catalog), Switzerland (190 dossiers | Catalog), Finland (67 dossiers | Catalog), France (474 dossiers | Catalog), South Korea (66 dossiers | Catalog), Norway (71 dossiers | Catalog), Italy (76 dossiers | Catalog), Philippines (410 dossiers | Catalog), Poland (43 dossiers | Catalog), South Africa (46 dossiers | Catalog), India (15 dossiers | Catalog), Belgium (82 dossiers | Catalog), Brazil (85 dossiers | Catalog), Japan (93 dossiers | Catalog), Netherlands (35 dossiers | Catalog), Russia (34 dossiers | Catalog), Sweden (49 dossiers | Catalog), China (31 dossiers | Catalog), Czechia (36 dossiers | Catalog), Germany (150 dossiers | Catalog), Denmark (43 dossiers | Catalog), Estonia (16 dossiers | Catalog), Spain (41 dossiers | Catalog), Israel (139 dossiers | Catalog), Iceland (15 dossiers | Catalog), Lithuania (0 dossiers | Catalog), Portugal (38 dossiers | Catalog), Saudi Arabia (44 dossiers | Catalog), Singapore (82 dossiers | Catalog), Ukraine (1 dossiers | Catalog).

Full plain-English executive briefings, structured HTML compliance matrices, semantic definition lists, two-stage Tables of Contents, authority RSS syndication feeds, and unabridged source PDF dossiers are accessible via each record's canonical URL on https://www.indexdata.org, the Complete Issuing Authority Directory, the AI/LLM manifests (llms.txt and llms-full.txt), and Wikidata entity Q142071440.
